command:
set -eu
if [ ! -r "${C1_LATENCY}" ]; then
  echo "no ${C1_LATENCY}: this kernel exposes no C1 idle state to cap against"
  exit 1
fi
want=$(cat "${C1_LATENCY}")
# fd 3 stays open for the life of this shell; closing it drops the request.
exec 3>"${PMQOS_DEV}"
printf '0x%08x' "${want}" >&3
value=$(od -An -td4 -N4 "${PMQOS_DEV}" | tr -d ' ')
if [ "${value}" != "${want}" ]; then
  echo "PM QoS request did not take: ${PMQOS_DEV} reads ${value} us, wanted ${want}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "cpu_dma_latency = ${want} us (C1 exit latency) on $(hostname)"
sleep infinity
containers.name: pmqos
